transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got a customer order for 1800 cartons of the new 750-milliliter format due by Monday morning, and Line 6 is available for a Saturday shift. I understand the new format has completed a dry fit on Line 6, but no production run has been authorized yet. That decision is mine to make. Before I can authorize anything, I need to go through our normal Saturday startup routine — quality, maintenance, and safety each need to report and formally record their findings. I'd like to hear from each of you on where things stand. Who wants to start?
